title: Create generated rules-pack data layout and loader
description:
Create the repo layout and loader path for generated rules-pack data so full packs are not hand-maintained as large TypeScript constants.

Expected shape should separate source manifests, intermediate extraction artifacts where useful, generated canonical records, and loader code.
acceptance_criteria:
- Generated data directory layout is defined.
- Loader can read generated pack artifacts.
- Generated artifacts are deterministic and stable under repeated imports.
- Existing tests can load both fixture and generated-pack paths as appropriate.
close_reason: loadRulesPackFromDirectory + seed pack data layout (manifest.json + records.json in rules__packId dirs) with 13 tests all passing
